name: AnchorPicker
description: Nine-position image-space anchor picker, with roving arrow-key focus.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting cell when uncontrolled. Defaults to the centre.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives a selected cell, from top left (0) through bottom right (8).

props.name: value
props.description: Selected cell in image space; pair with onValueChange to control it.
